props.descriptionFull:
Render as an inline activity indicator instead of a block loading state.

The default reserves a fixed 200px so a panel standing in for absent content does not collapse and then jump. Inline, that height is wrong: it strands the dots ~100px below the thing they belong to and centers them against surrounding text, which reads as frozen
